Reachable keeps the text of a hidden element and drops template content

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{hidden_content: "Reachable"}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>visible</p><div role=\"tabpanel\" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
